  First --> Hover["Hover: short definition"]
  First --> Click["Click: dialog"]
  Click --> Full["This page: long entry"]

Add or change a term in includes/glossary.json (unique id and aliases). Conventions: Project conventions.

docs.title: Klein 4B
docs.text:
FLUX.2 Klein 4B distilled FP8 is the default still engine in this studio. Distilled means quality is almost entirely the positive prompt: 4 steps, CFG 1.0, Qwen3-4B CLIP (flux2). Klein 9B is FLUX Non-Commercial and is not the lab default. See Klein, Wan, and LTX and Prompting.

Also called: FLUX.2 Klein 4B, FLUX.2 Klein, Klein

See also: T2I · Qwen3-4B · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5 · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: Wan 2.2
docs.text:
Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B is the silent motion lane. I2V prompts should be motion + one camera move — the start image owns look. Do not prompt audio or a score. Optional A14B and Fun InP packs are not part of download-models. See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: Wan 2.2 5B, TI2V-5B, Wan

See also: I2V · T2V · UMT5-XXL · LTX-2.5 · ping-pong

docs.title: LTX-2.5
docs.text:
LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot is the AV hero. Lab graphs load an audio VAE, concat empty audio latents with video latents, then decode audio into VHS so the MP4 has world sound. Landscape size is 1280×704 (VAE ÷32), not 1280×720. Accept the Hugging Face license and set HF_TOKEN before download-models. See Model licenses.

Also called: LTX

See also: joint AV · I2V · LTX Community License · gated model · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: Qwen3-4B
docs.text:
Klein stills encode prompts with qwen_3_4b as CLIP type flux2. Comfy wraps the string in a Qwen chat template — do not paste <|im_start|> into the widget. A separate Qwen3-4B-Instruct GGUF rewrites lazy sentences when Prompt Enhance is on (CPU-only). See Prompting.

Also called: qwen_3_4b, Qwen3

See also: Klein 4B · CLIP · GGUF · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: UMT5-XXL
docs.text:
Wan graphs load UMT5-XXL as CLIP type wan. T2V wants Entity + Scene + Motion + Aesthetic + one camera verb. I2V should drop look language so the start image stays in charge. See Prompting.

Also called: UMT5

See also: Wan 2.2 · CLIP · T2V · I2V

docs.title: Gemma 4
docs.text:
Seeded LTX graphs use CLIPLoader gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot with type ltxv. A DualCLIP or LTX-2.3 encoder on a 2.5 graph throws embedding-size errors. Write one present-tense paragraph with sound interleaved. See Prompting.

Also called: Gemma4

See also: LTX-2.5 · CLIP · joint AV

docs.title: ACE-Step
docs.text:
Native ACE-Step 1.5 ships in the Comfy pin. Podcast beds stay instrumental; rap graphs send original lyrics. download-music --tier turbo and download-podcast --tier acestep share the same AIO file. Occupancy: stop Klein/Wan/LTX first. See Local music and Local podcast.

Also called: ACE-Step 1.5

See also: occupancy · Kokoro · TTS

docs.title: Kokoro
docs.text:
Kokoro-82M is the US-safe default TTS (opt-in download-podcast --tier analog). Voices are stock identities, not clones of real people. The disclosure node prepends the spoken bumper so you do not type it. See Local podcast.

Also called: Kokoro-82M

See also: TTS · ACE-Step · disclosure bumper

docs.title: Chatterbox
docs.text:
Chatterbox Turbo is an opt-in TTS (download-podcast --tier chatterbox). Keep the PerTh watermark. Do not add celebrity reference WAVs. Kokoro remains the Spark-safe default. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · TTS · Local dub

docs.title: Chatterbox Multilingual
docs.text:
Default engine for Local dub. Cross-lingual clone from a 6–10 s ref extracted from this job, not a celebrity pack. Language transfer uses cfg_weight=0 so the target language does not keep the reference accent. Needs from_local(..., t3_model="v3") (GitHub pin CHATTERBOX_TTS_REF; PyPI 0.1.7 is too old) and setuptools<82 so PerTh (perth.PerthImplicitWatermarker) stays importable. Turbo English remains download-podcast --tier chatterbox.

Also called: Chatterbox Multilingual V3

See also: Chatterbox · Local dub · TTS

docs.title: CLIP
docs.text:
In this studio, “CLIP” means the model-specific text encoder: Qwen (flux2) for Klein, UMT5 (wan) for Wan, Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv) for LTX. Wrong CLIP type is a common Queue failure. See Image and video generation.

See also: Qwen3-4B · UMT5-XXL · Gemma 4 · KSampler

docs.title: VAE
docs.text:
A VAE compresses an image or video into latents and decodes latents back to pixels (and, for LTX, audio). Mixing a Wan VAE with an LTX graph will fail. LTX also needs the audio VAE so joint AV latents are not length-zero. See Image and video generation.

See also: latent · LTX-2.5 · Klein 4B · Wan 2.2

docs.title: UNET
docs.text:
Comfy loaders still say UNET for many diffusion transformers, including Klein and Wan. The filename on the canvas must match a weight under MODELS_DIR. Lab graphs pin those names; do not swap in Klein 9B or FLUX.2-dev. See Models and cache.

See also: KSampler · latent · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: GGUF
docs.text:
download-models places Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf under comfy/llm/. Prompt Enhance runs it CPU-only (n_gpu_layers=0) so it does not fight LTX for GB10 memory. Missing GGUF is fail-soft: generation still runs. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · Qwen3-4B · occupancy

docs.title: MagCache
docs.text:
MagCache skips some denoiser steps on the Wan 5 s smoke graph (extra.lab_magcache). Hero LTX prints and A14B graphs leave it off. If the node is missing, the Wan graph still Queues. See Motion workflows and Workflow catalog.

See also: Wan 2.2 · I2V

docs.title: Nunchaku
docs.text:
LAB_VISUAL_ENABLE_NUNCHAKU=0. Seeded Klein graphs use core UNET/CLIP/VAE loaders. Do not pip install nunchaku from PyPI (that is a stats library). aarch64 Spark wheels are skip-by-default. See Troubleshooting.

See also: Klein 4B · UNET

docs.title: SeedVR2
docs.text:
SeedVR2-3B is a post-concat restore (download-restore --tier seedvr2-3b). Conservative 1.3–1.5× on the master only. Occupancy: stop Comfy first if you restore on GPU. See 90s shorts.

Also called: SeedVR2-3B

See also: occupancy · last-frame continuity

docs.title: TRELLIS.2
docs.text:
download-3d --tier trellis2 pulls TRELLIS.2 native weights only. Never pip-install nvdiffrast/nvdiffrec. Stop the Comfy stack before a heavy 3D job. See Studio sidecars.

Also called: TRELLIS

See also: sidecar · occupancy · DA3-BASE

docs.title: DA3-BASE
docs.text:
Depth Anything 3 BASE is the allowed depth sidecar weight. --tier da3-large is banned. Same occupancy rule as TRELLIS: one heavy GPU job. See Studio sidecars.

Also called: DA3

See also: TRELLIS.2 · occupancy

docs.title: LongCat-Video
docs.text:
download-longcat --tier video is opt-in. Context-parallel needs an explicit allow flag. Independent Sparks still share MODELS_DIR; this sample stack does not ship in-tree NCCL. See Spark farm.

Also called: LongCat

See also: Spark farm · Wan 2.2

docs.title: DreamX-Creator
docs.text:
download-dreamx --tier creator only. Unload LTX/Wan 5B first. Not a lab default and not a 90s printer. See Model licenses.

Also called: DreamX

See also: joint AV · LTX-2.5

docs.title: Fun InP
docs.text:
download-wan --tier fun-inp then load wan/flf-5s. Unload LTX first. About ~47 GB on disk (status floor 40 GB). This is a continuity draft, not the 90s LTX print path. See 90s shorts.

See also: first-last-frame · Wan 2.2 · VACE

docs.title: VACE
docs.text:
VACE stitches the last frame of shot A toward the first frame of shot B as a short join clip. It is a Comfy graph, not a Docker sidecar. See Studio sidecars.

See also: Fun InP · last-frame continuity · Wan 2.2

docs.title: Z-Image Turbo
docs.text:
Z-Image Turbo uses different weights (ae, z_image_turbo_*). Seeded lab stills are Klein 4B. If a template asks for ae.safetensors, you loaded the wrong graph — open klein/still-draft. Optional: download-image --tier zimage. See Model licenses.

Also called: Z-Image

See also: Klein 4B · T2I

docs.title: VideoHelperSuite
docs.text:
Wan and LTX lab graphs wire VHS_VideoCombine with save_output: true. After Queue, open Save video (MP4) — open node for preview. Files land on the host at COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR. LTX also feeds decoded audio into VHS. See Still to motion to AV.

Also called: VHS_VideoCombine, VHS

See also: LTX-2.5 · Wan 2.2 · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: Qwen3-TTS
docs.text:
download-podcast --tier qwen3tts is opt-in. Empty reference audio stays on Kokoro. Do not use it to clone a real person. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · TTS

docs.title: FP8
docs.text:
FP8 keeps the default Klein 4B and several Wan files small enough for GB10. It is a storage/compute format, not a style. NVFP4 Klein is optional and still Apache for 4B. See Models and cache.

See also: Klein 4B · INT8-convrot

docs.title: INT8-convrot
docs.text:
Lab LTX-2.5 filenames include int8-convrot. If INT8-convrot or gated access fails, LTX-2.3 distilled FP8 is an optional fallback — seeded graphs still expect 2.5 names. See Models and cache.

See also: LTX-2.5 · FP8

docs.title: NVFP4
docs.text:
download-image --tier nvfp4 pulls the NVFP4 still weights plus the same TE + flux2-vae companions as fast. Lab daily stills stay distilled FP8. See Download tiers.

See also: Klein 4B · FP8 · download-image

docs.title: IC-LoRA
docs.text:
download-ltx --tier iclora pulls the 2.3 Union Control file used by official 2.5 IC-LoRA graphs. Distilled-only; 19B Union is refused. Unload other heavies first. See Download tiers and Film workflows.

Also called: iclora

See also: LTX-2.5 · LoRA · download-ltx · ControlNet

docs.title: DualCLIP
docs.text:
2.3 / balanced / quality auto-include Comfy-Org Gemma 3 (gemma pack) so DualCLIP can load. Seeded lab JSON still names LTX-2.5 Gemma4-with-proj (ltxv). Mixing them throws embedding-size errors. See Prompting.

See also: Gemma 3 · Gemma 4 · LTX-2.5 · CLIP

docs.title: Gemma 3
docs.text:
download-ltx --tier gemma (or any 2.3 alias) places gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed. Lab 2.5 printers use Gemma 4 with-proj instead. See Download tiers.

Also called: Gemma3

See also: Gemma 4 · DualCLIP · LTX-2.5 · download-ltx

docs.title: Wan A14B
docs.text:
download-wan --tier a14b. Included in Wan --tier all. MagCache stays off on A14B heroes. Occupancy: one Wan at a time. See Download tiers.

Also called: A14B

See also: Wan 2.2 · download-wan · Fun InP

docs.title: DINOv3
docs.text:
download-3d --tier trellis2 includes the DINOv3 companion next to TRELLIS.2 INT8. Do not substitute a random DINOv2 file. See Studio sidecars.

See also: TRELLIS.2 · download-3d

docs.title: nvdiffrast
docs.text:
Never pip install nvdiffrast / nvdiffrec into the Comfy venv. Native Comfy-Org TRELLIS.2 INT8 is the allowed path. See Studio sidecars.

See also: TRELLIS.2 · download-3d

docs.title: Qwen3.6-35B
docs.text:
download-llm --tier qwen36-35b-a3b then occupancy enter llm-desk --yes. Host llama-server on 127.0.0.1:30000 is the GPU job. The in-canvas 4B Prompt Enhance GGUF stays CPU-only. See Occupancy desk.

Also called: Qwen3.6

See also: llm-desk · download-llm · GGUF · llama-server

docs.title: T2I
docs.text:
Text-to-image is the first studio move. Queue klein/still-draft, then feed a PNG into Wan or LTX I2V if you want motion. See ComfyUI basics.

Also called: text-to-image

See also: Klein 4B · I2V · Queue

docs.title: I2V
docs.text:
Wan I2V is silent; LTX I2V can carry world audio. Point LoadImage at ez_still_draft_*.png (or a hero 1280×704 still for LTX). Do not re-describe wardrobe and location in an I2V prompt. See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: image-to-video

See also: T2V · LoadImage · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5

docs.title: T2V
docs.text:
Use T2V when you do not have a still you want to keep. Lab Wan T2V bypasses LoadImage. LTX T2V still wants a flowing paragraph with sound. See Prompting.

Also called: text-to-video

See also: I2V · Wan 2.2 · LTX-2.5

docs.title: A2V
docs.text:
ltx/a2v-5s encodes a ~5 s wav and muxes the original waveform. klein/talking-head is I2V smoke. Banned lip-sync OSS (Wav2Lip) stays out. Two-stage freeze lives in Comfy Templates → LTX-2.5. See Motion catalog.

Also called: audio-to-video

See also: S2V · LTX-2.5

docs.title: S2V
docs.text:
Wan S2V is opt-in (download-wan --tier s2v) and occupancy-heavy. Talking-head lab graphs mention it; they do not require it for the LTX freeze smoke. See Model licenses.

Also called: speech-to-video

See also: A2V · Wan 2.2

docs.title: joint AV
docs.text:
LTX is a joint audio/video model. Lab graphs must build empty audio latents and concat them before KSampler. Omitting that path yields a reshape error on length-zero audio. Wan stays silent on purpose (cleaner Apache motion). See Klein, Wan, and LTX.

Also called: AV hero

See also: LTX-2.5 · Wan 2.2 · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: first-last-frame
docs.text:
FLF is a continuity draft: you pick how the shot starts and ends. It is optional and large. 90s films instead chain last-frame PNG → next I2V start. See 90s shorts.

Also called: FLF

See also: Fun InP · last-frame continuity · I2V

docs.title: ping-pong
docs.text:
wan/gif-loop leaves VHS ping-pong on. Prompt cyclic motion (breeze, curtains), not a walk or one-way dolly, or reverse playback looks wrong. See Prompting.

See also: Wan 2.2 · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: Asset Bible
docs.text:
Each slug is an ez.asset.v1 record (kind, prompt, seed, pipeline, takes). scene.json instances slugs; it does not embed meshes. Gen is Klein still → TRELLIS.2. Construct is a shopping list of primitives + HDRI + bible refs. Operator verb today: asset-ls. See Asset Bible.

Also called: asset-bible

See also: Klein 4B · LTX-2.5 · TRELLIS.2

docs.title: ComfyUI
docs.text:
You operate the host with manage.sh; you use the studio in the browser at COMFY_PORT (default 8188). Graphs are nodes and widgets, not a chat box. Seeded files live under _lab/<lane>/ and copy into user/default/workflows/ on start. App Mode graphs land as *.app.json so they appear under Apps as well as Workflows. The canvas defaults to Nodes 2.0. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · widget · workflow · manage.sh · Nodes 2.0

docs.title: Nodes 2.0
docs.text:
Nodes 2.0 draws nodes as Vue DOM instead of LiteGraph canvas. Lab graphs stamp extra.workflowRendererVersion as Vue-corrected (canonical coordinates; do not stamp Vue or the frontend shrinks the layout). start seeds Comfy.VueNodes.Enabled when that key is absent. Toggle from the Comfy logo menu or Settings. See ComfyUI basics.

Also called: Vue nodes

See also: ComfyUI · workflow · widget

docs.title: workflow
docs.text:
Host files live under workflows/_lab/<lane>/. The entrypoint copies them into Comfy (*.app.json when App Mode is the default view). Do not edit raw JSON for daily use; type on the canvas. Every lab graph includes a Note node. Node-by-node widgets: Workflow details. See Workflow catalog and Still workflows.

Also called: node graph, lab graph

See also: lab-example · Note node · widget · ComfyUI

docs.title: Queue
docs.text:
Queue is the studio's play button. A still-draft Queue is minutes; a 5 s Wan/LTX Queue is minutes; a one-click 90s film Queue is 18 sequential 5 s prints (long wall-clock, not a 90s denoise). See ComfyUI basics.

See also: ComfyUI · KSampler · seed

docs.title: widget
docs.text:
Studio work is widget work: change the Positive prompt, seed, LoadImage filename, or Enhance toggle on the canvas. The JSON on disk stays the seeded lab example. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · workflow · Enhance · App Mode

docs.title: App Mode
docs.text:
App Mode shows the creator widgets listed in extra.linearData (Prompt, Style, Rewrite prompt, seed; LoadImage on I2V; size/UNET only on the daily still). Persist is [nodeId, widgetName, config] with an integer node id — frontend 1.49.6+ upgrades that to a live WidgetId. Two-part 11:prompt ids are dropped and the side panel looks empty. It is not a second frontend. The lab contract is lab_app_mode. Multi-shot Apps expose one identity prompt, not per-shot cards. Film graphs may open in graph view. On start, App Mode graphs seed as *.app.json so they appear in Comfy's Apps sidebar as well as Workflows. See ComfyUI Apps and ComfyUI basics.

See also: lab_app_mode · widget · occupancy · workflow · studio-ui

docs.title: lab_app_mode
docs.text:
extra.lab_app_mode marks a seeded graph as an App (enabled, default_view, lane inspire/produce/audio/film/dcc/optional, occupancy, handoff). default_view: app seeds as *.app.json (Apps + Workflows sidebars). Do not require extra.linearMode — Comfy upstream does not write it. See ComfyUI Apps.

See also: App Mode · occupancy · lab-example

docs.title: latent
docs.text:
LTX 5 s printers are 121 frames (1+8n) at 24 fps ≈ 5.04 s. Illegal 120 floors to 113 frames (4.71 s) and stitch refuses. Wan shot graphs stay 120 = 5.00 s. LTX spatial size must be divisible by 32 — lab landscape is 1280×704. Do not Queue a 30–90 s latent on GB10. See Image and video generation.

Also called: latent space

See also: VAE · KSampler · LTX-2.5

docs.title: KSampler
docs.text:
Distilled Klein uses 4 steps and CFG 1.0. Wan/LTX lab graphs pin steps, scheduler, and frame count on the canvas. Changing those widgets is how you experiment; changing them to a 90 s denoise is how you melt the Spark. See Image and video generation.

Also called: sampler

See also: CFG · seed · latent · Queue

docs.title: CFG
docs.text:
CFG 1.0 on distilled Klein means the positive prompt is the whole game. FLUX-family models do not use negatives well; put constraints in the positive (“unmarked facades”). See Prompting.

See also: Klein 4B · KSampler

docs.title: seed
docs.text:
Fix a seed when you iterate a prompt so lighting and identity do not jump. Identity sheets pin seed 42. Random seeds are for discovery, not for matching a still into I2V. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Queue · identity still

docs.title: Prompt Enhance
docs.text:
Klein/Wan/LTX Prompt Enhance defaults on for lazy CLIP printers and identity bibles you type. Seeded graphs pin it off for 90s films, talking-head, loops, camera-verb I2V, podcast scripts, and ACE tags/lyrics so the rewriter cannot mutate those inputs. The CLIP prompt box is visible on the node; after Queue it is the encoded string. Fail-soft if the GGUF is missing. See Prompting.

See also: Enhance · GGUF · Qwen3-4B

docs.title: world bible
docs.text:
Dream-house and style-lock graphs keep massing, materials, and inventory in a bible. Shot cards add a new camera (lock=view) or change only light (lock=state). Each view shot names its own room program and backdrop so interiors are different rooms, not one volume restyled and not one shared skyline. Identity-mode enhance keeps the bible camera-free. See Prompting.

See also: identity still · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: identity still
docs.text:
90s films Queue a Klein identity at 1280×704 (LTX grid), then 18 LTX prints that start from last frames. Enhance stays off so the rewriter cannot restyle the bible. See 90s shorts.

See also: Klein 4B · world bible · last-frame continuity

docs.title: lab-example
docs.text:
Shipped smokes live under workflows/_lab/<lane>/ with short stems (klein/still-draft.json). The unique id is extra.lab_rel. The old *-lab-example filename suffix is gone. Optional packs live under workflows/_lab/optional/ and shot YAML under workflows/shorts/. See Workflow catalog and Still workflows.

Also called: lab-example graphs

See also: workflow · Note node

docs.title: Note node
docs.text:
Every seeded graph includes a Comfy Note plus extra.lab_note. Read it before you Queue. It is the UI source of truth when docs and widgets disagree after a pull. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: lab-example · workflow

docs.title: LoadImage
docs.text:
After a still-draft Queue, set Wan/LTX LoadImage to ez_still_draft_*.png under COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR (the container sees /outputs). Leaving example.png is a smoke test only. See Still to motion to AV.

See also: I2V · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: Enhance
docs.text:
Enhance is the Prompt Enhance toggle. Seeded lab graphs pin it on for lazy CLIP printers and identity bibles you type, and off for authored recipes: 90s films, talking-head, loops, camera-verb I2V, podcast scripts, ACE tags/lyrics, and IC-LoRA. Turn it the other way in the App if you want. Identity mode keeps world bibles camera-free. I2V / FLF / VACE ignore style — the start frames own look. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · world bible

docs.title: Research Chat
docs.text:
No-UNET creative-process desk (inspire/research-chat). Queue a Message; read Reply and Sources. Mode research runs a planner plus 1–3 sequential search workers, then a synthesizer brief (prompt ingredients → Prompt Forge → Spark Still). Same on-box Qwen3-4B GGUF as Prompt Enhance (n_gpu_layers=0). HTTPS search is SSRF-safe. Laptop Path D: ./scripts/manage.sh research-mcp --stdio. See ComfyUI Apps and Occupancy desk.

Also called: research-chat, inspire/research-chat

See also: Prompt Enhance · occupancy · Qwen3-4B

docs.title: research-mcp
docs.text:
Typed stdio MCP (./scripts/manage.sh research-mcp). Tools: occupancy_status, list_lab_apps, describe_app, chat, web_search, research. Does not Queue Comfy, does not refuse a GPU session, does not map idle to blender-desk. No arbitrary URL fetch. Official Comfy Cloud MCP is out of tree. See Occupancy desk.

See also: Research Chat · occupancy · Path D

docs.title: Guide pack
docs.text:
The DCC ↔ Comfy print handshake. Lives under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/guides/<slug>/<shot>/. Size is the LTX VAE grid (1280×704 or 768×1280, never 1280×720). 120 frames @ 24 fps. Workbench clay + mist depth + outline canny. Occupancy XOR: stop Comfy before export-guides. See DCC guide pack.

Also called: guide pack, guide-pack, DCC guide pack

See also: LTX-2.5 · occupancy · sidecar

docs.title: house-views
docs.text:
Host Blender constructs a bpy-primitive set under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/assets/sets/<slug>/ (layout, GLB, clay, depth). Size is Instagram 4:5 (1024×1280), not the LTX guide pack. Stop Comfy first for the dump. manage.sh start seeds LoadImage plates (copy pack or render layout) so klein/dream-house-clay can Queue without Blender. Language-only tour → klein/dream-house. See Dream-house tours.

Also called: dream-house clay, clay tour

See also: Guide pack · occupancy · sidecar · Klein 4B

docs.title: blender-stills
docs.text:
Host Blender dumps ez.guide.still.v1 under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/guides/<slug>/stills/<plate>/. Sizes: 1280×704, 768×1280, 1024×1280, 1024×1024, 1280×720 (thumb, not LTX). Not the 5.00s shot pack and not house-views. Park Comfy (occupancy enter blender-desk) first. --install-inputs copies first.png into input/ while compose may stay up. Apps: klein-from-clay-plates, klein-from-canny. See Blender creator suite.

Also called: still pack, ez.guide.still.v1

See also: Guide pack · house-views · occupancy · sidecar · Klein 4B

docs.title: ezcmd
docs.text:
Flagged operator examples use a fenced ezcmd block whose body is id: <recipe> matching includes/command-builder.json. docs/hooks.py expands the fence into a copyable command with Your Spark chips. See Project conventions and manage.sh reference.

See also: manage.sh

docs.title: Occupancy gate
docs.text:
EZDCCOccupancyGate is a pass-through IMAGE node. It fail-closes against ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/.occupancy.json. A missing file passes (first-run). blender-desk versus a heavy mode fails. It does not start Compose, call Manager unload, or launch a host DCC. See Occupancy desk and Stay in Comfy after a Blender dump.

Also called: EZDCCOccupancyGate

See also: occupancy · XOR desk · blender-desk

docs.title: promote-workflow
docs.text:
./scripts/manage.sh promote-workflow --from PATH --lane LANE --id STEM copies a live _user graph into workflows/_lab/<lane>/. Optional --subdir. Does not commit. Refuses MiniMax / Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev / Seedance / Kling / z_image_turbo. Never copy _lab into _user. See manage.sh reference and Workflow catalog.

See also: workflow · lab-example · manage.sh

docs.title: studio-ui
docs.text:
docker compose --profile studio-ui up studio-ui serves a lights-only jobstore board at port 8190. No GPU. Default start skips it. App Mode is a ComfyUI widget surface on the same JSON — not this board. See 90s shorts and ComfyUI Apps.

See also: jobstore · App Mode

docs.title: clay
docs.text:
Shot guide packs dump clay.mp4 at 1280×704. Still packs dump clay PNGs at creator sizes. Dream-house clay is ten Instagram 4:5 plates. Occupancy XOR: park Comfy before the Blender dump. See Clay to finish.

See also: Guide pack · Canny · Blender · Workbench

docs.title: Canny
docs.text:
Guide packs write canny.mp4 or canny.png beside clay and depth. Klein-from-canny Apps restyle the outline; LTX IC-LoRA can consume Union Control. Size must match the VAE grid. See DCC guide pack.

See also: clay · Guide pack · IC-LoRA · ControlNet

docs.title: LoRA
docs.text:
The in-tree exception is LTX IC-LoRA Union Control (opt-in download). Do not drop random Civitai LoRAs onto Klein 4B or Wan 5B lab graphs. See Custom nodes.

See also: IC-LoRA · UNET · Klein 4B

docs.title: ControlNet
docs.text:
Do not install an SD1.5 ControlNet pack for Klein/Wan/LTX. DCC clay/depth/canny plus LTX IC-LoRA is the Spark-safe control path. See DCC guide pack.

See also: IC-LoRA · Canny · Guide pack

docs.title: Prompt Join
docs.text:
Dream-house walkthroughs keep massing in the bible and let each shot name camera + room. lock=view front-loads the new camera; lock=state changes only light. See Prompting and Dream-house tours.

See also: world bible · Prompt Enhance · identity still

docs.title: CLIP prompt
docs.text:
Empty until rewrite (or until you Queue with Enhance off, when it is your widget text). Use it to audit what the sampler saw. Fail-soft if the GGUF is missing. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · CLIP · Enhance

docs.title: Prompt Forge
docs.text:
Shared Prompt box plus family-specific CLIP strings. Context from Research Chat is ignored when Enhance is off. Occupancy llm. See ComfyUI Apps.

Also called: inspire/prompt-forge

See also: Research Chat · Beat Sheet · Prompt Enhance

docs.title: Beat Sheet
docs.text:
Feeds film and podcast rewrites so every card shares one episode spine. Occupancy llm. See ComfyUI Apps and 90s shorts.

Also called: inspire/beat-sheet

See also: Prompt Forge · Shot card · Research Chat

docs.title: SaveImage
docs.text:
Still-draft and identity plates land as ez_*.png. LTX last-frame index is 120 on a 121-frame clip. Point the next LoadImage at that file, not example.png. See Still to motion to AV.

See also: LoadImage · last-frame continuity · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR

docs.title: SaveAudio
docs.text:
Album tracks use stem NN - Song Title. For YouTube, mux a still with audio-still-video or upload the duration-locked dub WAV. See Local music.

See also: ACE-Step · audio-still-video · loudnorm

docs.title: Comfy Manager
docs.text:
Custom nodes in this stack are baked or bind-mounted (ez_*). Do not install MiniMax / Klein 9B / FLUX.2-dev packs from Manager. See Custom nodes.

Also called: ComfyUI-Manager

See also: ComfyUI · US-safe · Nunchaku

docs.title: Sage Attention
docs.text:
doctor may print attention: sage. Lab default is Kitchen (--use-ck-attention). Mixing Sage and Kitchen flags is a defect. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: Comfy Kitchen · pytorch-fallback · doctor

docs.title: VAE grid
docs.text:
1280×720 is illegal on LTX (VAE ÷32). Shorts use 768×1280. Klein identity plates for 90s films match the LTX grid. See Image and video generation.

Also called: 1280×704, 1280x704

See also: LTX-2.5 · latent · VAE

docs.title: 1+8n
docs.text:
LTX length must be 1+8n. Lab 5 s printers are 121. Typing 120 floors to 113 (4.71 s) and stitch refuses. Wan shot graphs stay 120 = 5.00 s; Wan smoke graphs are 121. See 90s shorts.

See also: latent · LTX-2.5 · last-frame continuity

docs.title: Your Spark
docs.text:
Injected into the article, not the Material header. Click a highlighted chip in any copyable command to edit the same keys. Defaults match .env.example. See Getting Started.

See also: ezcmd · env file · manage.sh

docs.title: blender-mcp
docs.text:
./scripts/manage.sh blender-mcp. Occupancy blender-desk for dumps. Does not vendor ahujasid. Laptop Path D tunnels stdio. See MCP.

See also: MCP · blender-desk · Path D · Blender

docs.title: MCP
docs.text:
In-tree: research-mcp and blender-mcp. No execute_code, no arbitrary URL fetch. Official Comfy Cloud MCP stays out of tree. See MCP and SSH tunnels.

See also: research-mcp · blender-mcp · Path D

docs.title: LiteGraph
docs.text:
Lab graphs stamp Vue-corrected coordinates so Nodes 2.0 does not shrink the layout. Toggle from the Comfy logo menu if you need the old canvas. See ComfyUI basics.

See also: Nodes 2.0 · Vue-corrected · ComfyUI

docs.title: Vue-corrected
docs.text:
Stamping Vue makes the frontend shrink the graph. Lab JSON uses Vue-corrected. See ComfyUI basics and Project conventions.

See also: Nodes 2.0 · workflow · LiteGraph

docs.title: Negative Prompt Enhance
docs.text:
Stops canned illustration / Pixar negatives from fighting the intended look. Same on-box GGUF as positive Prompt Enhance. See Prompting.

See also: Prompt Enhance · Klein 4B · CLIP

docs.title: Bazelisk
docs.text:
bazelisk run //:validate is the pre-PR gate. The Makefile is a shim. Bazel here is not K3s and not a dashboard. See Building with Bazel.

See also: occupancy

docs.title: download-limit
docs.text:
Full-rate multi-GB pulls freeze SSH. download-models wraps wondershaper when HTB works, else gentler HF workers. DOWNLOAD_LIMIT=off is an SSH risk. See Download limit.

Also called: download limit

See also: HTB · headroom · MODELS_DIR · --tier

docs.title: --tier
docs.text:
download-models has no --tier. Image fast, Wan 5b, and LTX 2.5 are three different pack ids that happen to be the lab defaults. Wan --tier all does not include vace or s2v. LTX --tier all is 2.5 + 2.3 + gemma (not iclora). --limit is Mbps, not a smaller model. See Download tiers.

Also called: pack selector, download tiers

See also: download-models · download-limit · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: download-models
docs.text:
Does not pull podcast, music, 3D, LongCat, DreamX, or SeedVR2. Those are opt-in utilities with their own --tier pack ids. Throttled by download-limit. See Download tiers and Models and cache.

See also: --tier · download-limit · MODELS_DIR · download-image · download-wan · download-ltx · download-llm

docs.title: download-image
docs.text:
download-image --tier fast is the still half of download-models. nvfp4 / base also pull Qwen TE + flux2-vae companions; zimage does not. There is no quality image tier (FLUX.2-dev is banned). See Download tiers.

Also called: download-image.sh

See also: --tier · download-models · Klein 4B · NVFP4 · Z-Image Turbo

docs.title: download-wan
docs.text:
download-wan --tier 5b is in download-models. a14b, Fun InP, VACE, and S2V are other graphs, not a quality ladder. --tier all is 5b + a14b + fun-inp and does not include vace or s2v. Unload LTX before Fun InP / VACE / S2V. See Download tiers.

Also called: download-wan.sh

See also: --tier · Wan 2.2 · Fun InP · VACE · S2V · Wan A14B

docs.title: download-ltx
docs.text:
download-ltx --tier 2.5 is in download-models. 2.3 is a retired fallback; balanced and quality are 2.3 aliases (quality is BF16, larger). 2.3 / balanced / quality auto-include Gemma 3 DualCLIP. --tier all is 2.5 + 2.3 + gemma and does not include iclora. See Download tiers.

Also called: download-ltx.sh

See also: --tier · LTX-2.5 · IC-LoRA · Gemma 3 · DualCLIP

docs.title: download-podcast
docs.text:
Not part of download-models. Default --tier analog is Kokoro only. acestep is the same ~10 GB AIO as download-music --tier turbo. Chatterbox and Qwen3-TTS are optional. Missing pack is not a doctor failure. Occupancy audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX first. See Local podcast.

See also: Kokoro · ACE-Step · download-music · occupancy

docs.title: download-dub
docs.text:
--tier asr is Silero VAD + faster-whisper. --tier clone is Chatterbox Multilingual V3 plus pkuseg. Missing pack is not a doctor failure. Occupancy audio. Playbook: Local dub.

See also: Local dub · ASR · Chatterbox Multilingual · pkuseg · --tier

docs.title: download-music
docs.text:
The closest thing this repo has to a size ladder. turbo reuses the podcast acestep snapshot — do not pull the ~10 GB AIO twice. Occupancy audio. See Local music and Download tiers.

See also: ACE-Step · download-podcast · occupancy

docs.title: download-3d
docs.text:
Default --tier trellis2 is Comfy-Org TRELLIS.2 INT8 + DINOv3. --tier da3-base is Apache depth. Never pip-install nvdiffrast. SuperSplat is a host viewer, not this downloader. See Studio sidecars.

See also: TRELLIS.2 · DA3-BASE · DINOv3 · nvdiffrast · SuperSplat

docs.title: download-llm
docs.text:
Default --tier enhance is the prompt-enhance Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M (already pulled by download-models). --tier qwen36-35b-a3b is the occupancy llm-desk 35B pack (~23 GB). Do not add 35B to download-models. See Occupancy desk.

See also: GGUF · Prompt Enhance · llm-desk · Qwen3.6-35B

docs.title: pack id
docs.text:
Each download utility has its own pack ids (fast, 5b, 2.5, analog, …). Image fast is not “better Wan”. --limit is bandwidth in Mbps. See Download tiers.

See also: --tier · download-limit · download-models

docs.title: cache hit
docs.text:
status / run treat a pack as ready when keep-set files exist and size meets min_gb. A TE-only Klein partial cannot cache-hit skip the VAE. See Models and cache.

See also: MODELS_DIR · download-models · *.incomplete

docs.title: *.incomplete
docs.text:
Stuck ↓ 0 MiB/s with found N incomplete means resume is not growing. Ctrl+C, then --drop-incomplete or reset-hf-partials --yes. Finished .safetensors stay. See Download limit and Downloads troubleshooting.

Also called: incomplete file

See also: download-limit · Hugging Face · --drop-incomplete

docs.title: hf download
docs.text:
setup and download-models install hf into ~/.local/bin. Do not prefix download-models with sudo (sudo PATH hides that). The stub huggingface-cli is deprecated here. See Download packs.

Also called: Hugging Face CLI

See also: Hugging Face · download-models · HF_TOKEN

docs.title: reap-models
docs.text:
manage.sh reap-models --plan is read-only. Review-class moves to quarantine. --drop-pack will not delete a VAE still needed by another pack. cleanup is the comfy-state volume only. See Disk wizard and Models and cache.

See also: disk-wizard · quarantine · MODELS_DIR · cleanup

docs.title: --drop-incomplete
docs.text:
Use on download-models when resume sits at 0 MiB/s. Same idea as reset-hf-partials --yes. Do not FORCE-clear .lock files while hf is still writing. See Downloads troubleshooting.

See also: *.incomplete · download-models · clear-hf-locks

docs.title: clear-hf-locks
docs.text:
manage.sh clear-hf-locks (auto on download-models). HF_LOCK_CLEAR_FORCE=1 only if no hf process is running. See Downloads troubleshooting.

Also called: HF locks

See also: *.incomplete · Hugging Face · --drop-incomplete

docs.title: DGX Spark
docs.text:
ez-comfy-stack is a sample studio for a single DGX Spark. Independent Sparks may share MODELS_DIR (Spark farm) but there is no in-tree NCCL. SSH recoverability drives restart: no, headroom, and download-limit. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: Spark

See also: GB10 · headroom · Spark farm · restart: no

docs.title: GB10
docs.text:
There is no separate giant VRAM pool. Compose mem_limit is 90g so the host keeps headroom for SSH. One heavy job at a time. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: unified memory · headroom · occupancy

docs.title: unified memory
docs.text:
The stack applies patch_unified_memory_copy.py (copy=False on safetensor .to(device)) and patch_get_free_memory.py (host free RAM instead of under-reporting cudaMemGetInfo). --highvram is the wrong flag here. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: GB10 · headroom · Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: occupancy
docs.text:
GB10 is one GPU. occupancy enter blender-desk parks Comfy (POST /free) for host Workbench dumps. occupancy enter llm-desk parks Comfy and starts the host 35B llama-server (127.0.0.1:30000). NVENC/proxies still want Compose down. Do not load Klein + Wan + LTX + TRELLIS + llm-desk in one session. App occupancy keys (none/llm/klein/wan/ltx/film/audio/trellis) are graph labels — llm is not a CLI mode. See Occupancy desk, Occupancy matrix, MCP, and Studio sidecars.

See also: sidecar · ACE-Step · GB10 · App Mode · park · XOR desk · blender-desk · llm-desk · Path D

docs.title: headroom
docs.text:
doctor and start refuse when host free RAM is below policy (min_host_free_gib). Do not weaken this for demos. See Reboot safety and Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: restart: no · doctor · unified memory

docs.title: restart: no
docs.text:
A remotely managed Spark that relaunches a 90g GPU job on boot is how you lose SSH. Always manage.sh stop before reboot. Independent farm nodes use the same policy. See Reboot safety.

Also called: restart: "no"

See also: headroom · manage.sh · DGX Spark

docs.title: disk-wizard
docs.text:
Surveys MODELS_DIR junk, Hugging Face hub cache, Docker build cache, Ollama/vLLM leftovers, and other experiment residue on a Spark that runs more than this studio. --plan is read-only. Review-class items quarantine. Never docker system prune -a --volumes. cleanup still only removes the comfy-state volume. See Disk wizard.

Also called: disk wizard

See also: quarantine · MODELS_DIR · download-models

docs.title: quarantine
docs.text:
reap-models --quarantine and disk-wizard review-class actions move files to a timestamped tree with a JSONL manifest. Restore with the matching restore --from command. Junk class may delete in place. See Disk wizard.

See also: disk-wizard · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: HTB
docs.text:
When sch_htb is absent, downloads continue with a warning and gentler Hugging Face settings. That is not a license to set DOWNLOAD_LIMIT=off. See Download limit.

Also called: wondershaper

See also: download-limit

docs.title: MODELS_DIR
docs.text:
Weights live on the host so GHCR images stay small and multiple stacks can share one cache. cleanup does not delete MODELS_DIR. See Models and cache.

See also: comfy-state · GHCR · COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR · three stores

docs.title: COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR
docs.text:
cleanup does not delete outputs. status prints the path. Look here after Queue, not inside the git repo. See Getting Started.

See also: MODELS_DIR · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: comfy-state
docs.text:
First start seeds the volume from /opt/comfy-prebuilt. Weights are not in this volume. Resetting it does not re-download Klein/Wan/LTX. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: GHCR · MODELS_DIR · three stores

docs.title: GHCR
docs.text:
main → ghcr.io/toxicoder/ez-comfy:us-safe-studio; development and feature branches → -development. The image has Comfy+torch, not Klein/Wan/LTX weights. Old flux-to-ltx* tags freeze. See Getting Started.

See also: comfy-state · MODELS_DIR · us-safe-studio · three stores

docs.title: US-safe
docs.text:
Defaults: Apache Klein 4B + Apache Wan 2.2 + LTX-2.5 Community (gated, $10M cap). MiniMax H3 is a US Excluded Territory ban for weights and outputs. Read Model licenses before a 30 GB pull.

See also: LTX Community License · Apache 2.0 · MiniMax H3

docs.title: manage.sh
docs.text:
Run from the repo root. It loads .env. Studio users still Queue in the browser; operators keep SSH alive with this tool. Full catalog: manage.sh reference.

See also: doctor · restart: no · download-limit · ezcmd · promote-workflow

docs.title: doctor
docs.text:
Fix hard doctor failures before download-models. Missing lab weights are a warning, not a hard fail. attention: pytorch-fallback on a running Spark is a 10–20× slow path. See Troubleshooting.

See also: manage.sh · headroom · Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: HF_TOKEN
docs.text:
Klein 4B and Wan 5B are Apache. LTX-2.5 still needs you to open the model card as that user and click Agree. Fine-grained tokens need gated-repo read. See Model licenses.

See also: gated model · LTX-2.5

docs.title: gated model
docs.text:
A token in .env is not the same as accepting the Lightricks license. download-models exits non-zero until the distilled LTX set is on disk. See Getting Started.

Also called: gated repo

See also: HF_TOKEN · LTX-2.5 · LTX Community License

docs.title: Comfy Kitchen
docs.text:
doctor prints attention: kitchen|sage|pytorch-fallback|unknown. Never pass --use-sage-attention next to Kitchen. spark-timing refuses to record unless Kitchen is live. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: Kitchen attention

See also: pytorch-fallback · doctor

docs.title: pytorch-fallback
docs.text:
If doctor says attention: pytorch-fallback while compose is up, do not record spark-timing and do not treat mushy video as a prompt problem. See Troubleshooting.

See also: Comfy Kitchen

docs.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit
docs.text:
setup --install-docker configures nvidia-ctk when present. Snap Docker is the wrong install. See Getting Started.

See also: DGX Spark · manage.sh

docs.title: park
docs.text:
occupancy enter blender-desk or occupancy enter llm-desk waits for an empty queue, then POST /free {unload_models, free_memory}. Compose may stay up. That is not stop (container down). NVENC still wants Compose down. Parked Comfy is not a second denoise. See Occupancy desk and Occupancy matrix.

Also called: parked Comfy

See also: occupancy · blender-desk · llm-desk · XOR desk

docs.title: XOR desk
docs.text:
GB10 is one GPU. NVENC proxies, Cycles CUDA, LTX, TRELLIS, and llm-desk are mutually exclusive. blender-desk is Workbench after park, not a second CUDA denoise. Graph occupancy label llm is not a CLI mode. See Occupancy desk and Occupancy matrix.

Also called: occupancy XOR, xor-desk

See also: occupancy · park · blender-desk · llm-desk · NVENC

docs.title: us-safe-studio
docs.text:
main pulls ghcr.io/toxicoder/ez-comfy:us-safe-studio; development and feature branches pull :us-safe-studio-development. Compose env LAB_VISUAL_PROFILE=us-safe-studio. The image has Comfy+torch, not Klein/Wan/LTX weights. See Getting Started and Models and cache.

Also called: us-safe-studio-development

See also: GHCR · US-safe · three stores

docs.title: Path D
docs.text:
Path D is a laptop client over SSH (ssh -L to Comfy, research-mcp / blender-mcp stdio, or llm-desk 127.0.0.1:30000). Spark runs the server; the laptop is the MCP/agent client. Occupancy CLI modes stay idle / blender-desk / llm-desk / klein / trellis / wan / ltx — Path D is not a fourth mode. See Occupancy desk and MCP.

Also called: path-d

See also: occupancy · llm-desk · research-mcp

docs.title: blender-desk
docs.text:
occupancy enter blender-desk parks Comfy when Compose is up. Host Workbench dumps (export-guides, blender-stills, house-views) are allowed. Cycles CUDA and NVENC still XOR. Does not start Compose. See Occupancy desk and Occupancy matrix.

See also: park · occupancy · XOR desk · sidecar

docs.title: llm-desk
docs.text:
occupancy enter llm-desk --yes parks Comfy (POST /free when up) and starts host llama-server on 127.0.0.1:30000. That sidecar is the GPU job. Graph occupancy label llm is not this mode. One-time pull: download-llm --tier qwen36-35b-a3b (not download-models). See Occupancy desk and Occupancy matrix.

See also: park · occupancy · XOR desk · Path D

docs.title: three stores
docs.text:
The GHCR image holds Comfy+torch (no Klein/Wan/LTX weights). MODELS_DIR holds weights on the host. The comfy-state volume holds the Comfy install. cleanup (type DELETE) removes the volume only. Outputs stay in COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR. See Models and cache and Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: three-stores

See also: GHCR · MODELS_DIR · comfy-state

docs.title: Blender
docs.text:
Not a Compose service. occupancy enter blender-desk then export-guides / blender-stills / house-views. Cycles CUDA still XOR with LTX. See Occupancy desk.

See also: blender-desk · Cycles · Workbench · sidecar

docs.title: Cycles
docs.text:
Workbench OpenGL dumps can run after park; Cycles CUDA is a second denoise. Stop Comfy or stay parked. See Occupancy matrix.

See also: Blender · XOR desk · occupancy · NVENC

docs.title: Workbench
docs.text:
blender-desk is Workbench after POST /free. Clay / mist / outline passes for guide packs use this. Cycles CUDA is the XOR case. See Blender creator suite.

See also: blender-desk · Blender · clay · Guide pack

docs.title: SuperSplat
docs.text:
Occupancy with Comfy like other sidecars. Gaussian splat weights are opt-in elsewhere; this is the viewer. See Splat sidecar.

See also: sidecar · occupancy · TRELLIS.2

docs.title: Hugging Face
docs.text:
HF_TOKEN authenticates. Open the LTX-2.5 model card as that user and click Agree. Klein 4B and Wan 5B are Apache. See Model licenses and HF tokens.

See also: HF_TOKEN · gated model · hf download · LTX-2.5

docs.title: Docker Compose
docs.text:
manage.sh start / stop wrap Compose. Prefer apt Docker CE, not snap. See Getting Started and When to use vs spark-lab.

See also: restart: no · mem_limit · snap Docker · Docker CE

docs.title: env file
docs.text:
setup copies .env.example when missing. Put HF_TOKEN, MODELS_DIR, COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR, DOWNLOAD_LIMIT here. Docs chips store the same keys in the browser; they do not write .env. See Getting Started.

See also: Your Spark · HF_TOKEN · MODELS_DIR · download-limit

docs.title: SSH
docs.text:
Full-rate Hugging Face pulls freeze interactive SSH. Laptop UIs use ssh -L. Always manage.sh stop before reboot. See Reboot safety.

See also: headroom · download-limit · restart: no · Path D

docs.title: ffmpeg
docs.text:
Not in the Docker image on purpose. podcast-loudnorm.sh and audio-still-video refuse to skip. NVENC proxies also need it (Compose down). See 90s shorts.

See also: concat-shots · loudnorm · NVENC · audio-still-video

docs.title: NCCL
docs.text:
LongCat context-parallel needs an explicit allow flag and is still not in-tree NCCL. Graduate to nvidia-dgx-spark-lab for multi-node. See Spark farm.

See also: Spark farm · LongCat-Video · DGX Spark

docs.title: --highvram
docs.text:
CPU and GPU share one pool. The stack patches safetensor copies and free-memory reporting instead. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

Also called: highvram

See also: unified memory · GB10 · headroom

docs.title: snap Docker
docs.text:
setup --install-docker installs Docker CE. Snap Docker breaks NVIDIA Container Toolkit paths. See Getting Started.

See also: Docker CE · NVIDIA Container Toolkit · Docker Compose

docs.title: mem_limit
docs.text:
GB10 unified memory is shared with the OS. mem_limit / mem_reservation stay explicit. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: headroom · GB10 · Docker Compose

docs.title: llama.cpp
docs.text:
In-canvas Qwen3-4B uses n_gpu_layers=0. Dub rewrite needs the wheel importable (download-dub heals it). 35B writing desk is a separate sidecar. See Prompting.

See also: GGUF · llama-server · Prompt Enhance · Local dub

docs.title: llama-server
docs.text:
occupancy enter llm-desk --yes starts it after parking Comfy. Bind 0.0.0.0 is refused. Path D SSH-tunnels the port. See Occupancy desk.

See also: llm-desk · Qwen3.6-35B · Path D · llama.cpp

docs.title: Docker CE
docs.text:
setup --install-docker installs docker-ce + the Compose v2 plugin and adds your user to docker. Then newgrp docker or re-login. See Getting Started.

See also: snap Docker · Docker Compose · NVIDIA Container Toolkit

docs.title: spark-timing
docs.text:
doctor prints attention: kitchen|sage|pytorch-fallback|unknown. Do not record on pytorch-fallback. See Hardware, memory, and safety.

See also: Comfy Kitchen · pytorch-fallback · doctor

docs.title: sch_htb
docs.text:
qdisc kind is unknown is expected on many Sparks. Wrap warns and continues with gentler HF workers. DOWNLOAD_LIMIT=off is still an SSH risk. See Download limit.

See also: HTB · download-limit · SSH

docs.title: cleanup
docs.text:
Weights, PNG/MP4, and _user graphs stay on the host. First start after cleanup re-seeds the volume from the GHCR image. See Models and cache.

Also called: type DELETE

See also: comfy-state · three stores · MODELS_DIR

docs.title: last-frame continuity
docs.text:
18 × 5.00 s LTX prints (121 frames = 1+8n @ 24 fps) stitch under a 90.00 s cap. One-click film graphs chain this inside Comfy; print-shot / film-resume do it on the host jobstore. See 90s shorts.

See also: identity still · LTX-2.5 · film-accept

docs.title: OTIO
docs.text:
manage.sh film-export-otio go-see writes stdlib JSON under films/<slug>/publish/. Import on the Spark host or a laptop. Occupancy: stop Comfy if the NLE will use the GPU. See Studio sidecars.

See also: sidecar · jobstore

docs.title: NVENC
docs.text:
film-proxies and nvenc-preview.sh refuse while compose is up. They never rewrite masters. See 90s shorts.

See also: occupancy · film-accept

docs.title: film-accept
docs.text:
manage.sh film-accept go-see (and concat --film --yes) refuse shots that drift. --skip-accept is an escape hatch, not a default. See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · LTX-2.5

docs.title: jobstore
docs.text:
A dropped SSH session is not a two-hour requeue: film-resume skips ok 5.00 s shots. Optional studio-ui on :8190 is lights only (no GPU). See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · film-accept · studio-ui

docs.title: Shot card
docs.text:
shot-sheet writes films/<slug>/shots.yaml with fail-closed defaults (clay: skip, audio_policy: world-only). Lab workflows/shorts/*.shots.yaml stay golden fixtures. See Clay to finish.

Also called: shot card, shot-card

See also: Guide pack · film-accept

docs.title: overlay-qc
docs.text:
Host ffmpeg; compose may stay up. Writes overlay.png and score.json. Human still picks; the score only ranks. See Clay to finish.

Also called: overlay QC

See also: Guide pack · occupancy

docs.title: film-animatic
docs.text:
manage.sh film-animatic --film go-see concats clay clips or 5.00 s still holds, cap 90 s. Not a 90 s denoise. See Clay to finish.

Also called: animatic

See also: Guide pack · Shot card

docs.title: loudnorm
docs.text:
podcast-loudnorm.sh is a hard fail if ffmpeg is missing — it will not skip. 90s publish graphs apply YouTube loudnorm in EZFilmConcat. See Local podcast.

See also: TTS · VideoHelperSuite

docs.title: sidecar
docs.text:
Sidecars stay off the Docker image on purpose. manage.sh blender dies if Comfy is a heavy job; park with occupancy enter blender-desk. See Occupancy desk and Occupancy matrix.

See also: occupancy · TRELLIS.2 · XOR desk · blender-desk

docs.title: Spark farm
docs.text:
Farm mode Queues different beats on different hosts. Concat stays on one machine. spark-farm.sh never starts compose on a remote node (each node still types yes locally). See Spark farm.

See also: DGX Spark · MODELS_DIR · restart: no

docs.title: concat-shots
docs.text:
concat-shots.sh --film go-see --yes is the host fallback. It writes a faststart H.264 master plus ez_*_90s.html. --xfade is audio-only and refuses Wan-silent shots. See 90s shorts.

See also: last-frame continuity · film-accept

docs.title: print-shot
docs.text:
manage.sh print-shot. One-click film graphs chain this inside Comfy instead. See 90s shorts.

See also: film-resume · jobstore · last-frame continuity

docs.title: film-resume
docs.text:
manage.sh film-resume <slug>. A dropped session is not a two-hour requeue. See 90s shorts.

See also: print-shot · jobstore · SSH

docs.title: take-promote
docs.text:
manage.sh take-promote. Use after human pick, not as a default concat path. See 90s shorts.

See also: jobstore · film-accept · concat-shots

docs.title: world-only
docs.text:
shot-sheet defaults audio_policy: world-only. Stems are DX/BG/FX/MX after picture lock. See Clay to finish.

See also: Shot card · stem-mix · LTX-2.5

docs.title: picture-lock
docs.text:
LTX joint AV is the world bed, not the master. Duck MX −15 dB; YouTube loudnorm −14 LUFS. See Clay to finish.

See also: stem-mix · loudnorm · film-accept

docs.title: film-proxies
docs.text:
manage.sh film-proxies. Encoder contention on GB10. Occupancy: Compose down. See 90s shorts.

See also: NVENC · occupancy · jobstore

docs.title: Kdenlive
docs.text:
film-export-otio writes stdlib JSON under films/<slug>/publish/. Shotcut is the other supported NLE. See Studio sidecars.

See also: OTIO · Shotcut · sidecar

docs.title: Shotcut
docs.text:
Import on the Spark host or a laptop. GPU preview XOR with Comfy. See Studio sidecars.

See also: OTIO · Kdenlive · sidecar

docs.title: Local dub
docs.text:
The audio/dub/localize App transcribes with faster-whisper (segments become turns), clusters speakers with Chatterbox ve.pt, merges same-speaker gaps under 0.35 s, writes 6–10 s per-speaker clone refs, translates each turn with the on-box GGUF (ISO source → target), and clones each voice (Chatterbox Multilingual V3, language_id like es, Clone CFG auto 0 on EN→ES). Clones are onset-cropped (Chatterbox hush / PerTh floor) and T3 is capped per line so a 1000-token walk cannot overlay a silent intro then a tonal drone. Duration lock pitch-preserves up to 1.25×, then spills, then fade-trims — it does not crush a long clone into the original window. First Queue is Stage all (analyze then clone). To edit text_target first, use Stage analyze then Stage render. Pick or upload a file from input/ (or set a Source URL). I have rights must be on. Occupancy audio. After Queue, Dub status lists speaker/turn counts and translated N/M. Missing ASR, clone, llama.cpp, or GGUF yields an empty mix plus that status, not the original recording and not English cloned as the target. Wheels install separately (Chatterbox GitHub zip --no-deps so torch 2.14 stays; PyPI 0.1.7 has no t3_model=v3). YouTube Studio wants the duration-locked job-dir ez_dub_yt.wav, not the Comfy preview MP3 and not a muxed multi-track MP4. See Local dub.

Also called: dub-localize

See also: Chatterbox · TTS · occupancy · disclosure bumper · YouTube multi-language audio

docs.title: YouTube multi-language audio
docs.text:
YouTube does not reliably ingest extra AAC tracks muxed into an MP4. Export the duration-locked job-dir ez_dub_yt.wav (not the Comfy 24 kHz preview MP3), upload it under Languages → Audio, add the translated SRT, and use the synthetic/altered-content toggle. Eligibility varies by channel. See Local dub.

Also called: multi-language audio, MLA

See also: Local dub · loudnorm

docs.title: Before download-models
docs.text:
LTX-2.5 is gated. Klein 4B and Wan 5B are Apache and do not need a license click.

  1. Create or edit .env with HF_TOKEN=hf_... (or hf auth login)
  2. In a browser, as that same user, open https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 and click Agree
  3. Fine-grained tokens need gated repo read
  4. ./scripts/manage.sh download-models (hf is auto-installed; token in .env is enough — no extra hf auth login if HF_TOKEN is set)

A token in .env is not the same as accepting the Lightricks license. First-run path: Getting Started.

docs.title: Why these defaults
docs.text:
Still (Apache 2.0): FLUX.2 Klein 4B distilled FP8 is the official ComfyUI Klein 4B path (flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors, qwen_3_4b.safetensors, flux2-vae.safetensors). Distilled = 4 steps, CFG 1.0. Klein 9B is FLUX Non-Commercial — not fine for monetized YouTube as a lab default. FLUX.2 [dev] is not a casual-commercial default.

Runner-up still: Z-Image Turbo (Apache 2.0, native Comfy templates). Optional download-image --tier zimage if Klein 4B quality disappoints. Qwen-Image is the slower quality sibling — documented only, not a default download.

Silent motion (Apache 2.0): Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B is the daily driver (T2V + I2V, official Comfy templates). No native audio. Wan 2.2 A14B is an optional hero (download-wan --tier a14b), not the first download.

Audio + video (not Apache): LTX-2.5 distilled INT8-convrot is the AV hero. LTX Community License: free commercial under $10M COMPANY annual revenue (affiliates count); no US geo-ban; disclose AI-generated media; do not strip provenance; do not distill into a competing model. Hugging Face repo is gated — accept the license and set HF_TOKEN before download-models. Lab download is the small distilled set, not the 400 GB monorepo.

LTX-2.3: optional fallback (download-ltx --tier 2.3) if 2.5 access or INT8-convrot fails. Not advertised as 30 s / 60 s films.

90s films: Klein identity still + 18 × LTX 5.00s print (world audio, no score), stitch with a 90s cap. Do not Queue a 90s latent. See 90s shorts.

Omitted: LongCat-Video (custom-node risk). HunyuanVideo 1.5 (US-legal but territorial clause for other countries — not the one-stack default).

docs.title: Banned
docs.text:
Do not download, do not reference in lab graphs, do not pin Comfy for them:

  • MiniMax H3 (US Excluded Territory for weights and outputs)
  • MiniMax Music 3 as a lab default
  • Suno / Udio partner APIs
  • FLUX.2 [dev] as any default or “quality” tier
  • FLUX.2 Klein 9B as the default image model
  • API-only models (Wan 2.5/2.6/2.7/3.0, Seedance, Kling, Veo, fal, Comfy Cloud, MiniMax API)
  • F5-TTS official weights (CC-BY-NC-4.0), Coqui XTTS v2 (CPML), Echo-TTS (CC-BY-NC-SA)
  • Fish Audio S2 (research/NC), Higgs Boson (community/commercial traps)
  • TTS-Audio-Suite as a pack; OldTimeRadio as a pack (H3 / FLUX-dev / NC optional lanes)
  • nvdiffrast / nvdiffrec TRELLIS, DA3-LARGE, Inria 3DGS, Pixal3D-as-default
  • DreamX-World (Creator 1.0 Apache only)
  • Wav2Lip OSS
  • LTX-2 19B IC-LoRA Union Control (Lightricks/LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Union-Control)

Opt-in local podcast (not in download-models): Kokoro-82M Apache TTS, native ACE-Step 1.5 MIT instrumental beds, optional Chatterbox MIT / Qwen3-TTS Apache. See Local podcast. Opt-in local dub: Silero VAD + faster-whisper large-v3 (MIT) + Chatterbox Multilingual V3 (MIT, PerTh on). See Local dub. Opt-in local rap: same ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO via download-music --tier turbo (shared dest with download-podcast --tier acestep). See Local music.

./scripts/manage.sh download-models refuses MiniMax H3.

What's on this page

docs.title: Models & Cache
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Three stores (GHCR image, MODELS_DIR, comfy-state volume)
  • Default location and permissions for ${MODELS_DIR} and ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR} layout dirs
  • Layout (tier dirs, relative comfy/ symlinks, reap)
  • Pack map pointing at download utilities (download-image.sh, download-wan.sh, download-ltx.sh, download-llm.sh)

What this enables

  • Downloading Klein 4B, Wan 2.2, and LTX-2.5 weights once and reusing them across stacks
  • Keeping weights off the GHCR image (us-safe-studio)
  • Checking the tree without network access

Who this is for: operators setting MODELS_DIR before download-models.

Operator path

Most operators only need: set MODELS_DIR → download-models → confirm basenames. Layer pins, gated tokens, and multi-stack sharing are linked below.

  • Gated models

    LTX-2.5 needs a Hugging Face license click. HF_TOKEN is not that click.

    HF_TOKEN

  • Multi-stack sharing

    One MODELS_DIR for this Docker stack and nvidia-dgx-spark-lab hostPath.

    Sharing

  • Which --tier

    Pack id per downloader, not a quality ladder. --limit is Mbps.

    Download tiers

  • Download packs

    Basenames, example graphs, LTX selective download, resume, GHCR pins.

    Packs

docs.title: Three stores
docs.text:
Store Holds Not held here GHCR image ComfyUI + PyTorch Klein / Wan / LTX weights MODELS_DIR Weights + comfy/ relative symlinks The Comfy venv comfy-state volume Comfy install, lab ez_* custom nodes Host PNGs/MP4s, start images, Comfy user/, operator _user node packs (COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR)

cleanup (type DELETE) removes comfy-state only. Generated media, LoadImage start frames (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/input), Comfy user workflows (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user), and operator custom nodes (${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/custom-nodes-user) stay on the host. Concepts: Hardware, memory, and safety.

docs.title: Persistence (survives stop / image pull)
docs.text:
What Host Container On start Model weights ${MODELS_DIR:-/mnt/models} /models persist Generated PNG/MP4/audio ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR:-/mnt/comfy-output} /outputs (COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR=/outputs in the container) persist LoadImage inputs ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/input /inputs persist Comfy user/ (sidebar, history) ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user /comfy-state/ComfyUI/user (--user-directory) persist Live lab graphs …/comfy-user/default/workflows/_lab/ same overwrite from repo workflows/_lab/ Live operator graphs …/comfy-user/default/workflows/_user/ same never overwrite Operator JSON saved under _lab/ same tree same rescue into _user/ (extras) or _user/_rescued/ (edited lab graphs), then lab overwrite Other files under live workflows same tree same never touch Lab custom nodes ez_* git custom_nodes/ $COMFY_HOME/custom_nodes/ez_* overwrite Operator custom nodes ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/custom-nodes-user $COMFY_HOME/custom_nodes/_user persist (pin refresh excludes this tree) Comfy install + venv Docker volume ez-comfy-state /comfy-state persist until cleanup

seed_from_prebuilt skips root-anchored /user/, /input/, /output/, /temp/, /extra_model_paths.yaml, and /custom_nodes/_user/ so a pin refresh cannot delete Manager-installed packs that live on the host bind. Anchoring matters: unanchored input/ also dropped nested comfy_api/input (ComfyUI v0.34+ Curve/Range types) and ComfyUI crashed on import. Stamp-present refresh heals that package from /opt/comfy-prebuilt even when .lab-comfyui-ref already matches COMFYUI_REF. Lab packs named ez_* still overwrite from /opt/ez-comfy/custom_nodes.

docs.title: Default location
docs.text:
export MODELS_DIR="${MODELS_DIR:-/mnt/models}"

Override in .env if needed. Prefer a large, durable disk on the Spark.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text:
doctor requires MODELS_DIR to be writable by the current user (check only; no sudo). Nested ${MODELS_DIR}/comfy can still be root-owned after a container start — that is a warning, not a hard doctor failure.

setup, download-models, and start sudo-heal ${MODELS_DIR}/comfy and each layout subdir (and the dest dir of each relative symlink) when they are not writable. They do not recurse chown over HF snapshots under MODELS_DIR. Do not prefix download-models with sudo (download-limit uses sudo internally; hf must stay on the login user's PATH).

Preferred (setup / download-models)Manual last resortHome path 
./scripts/manage.sh setup
./scripts/manage.sh download-models
# sudo mkdir -p + chown for MODELS_DIR and MODELS_DIR/comfy when needed

sudo mkdir -p "${MODELS_DIR}/comfy"
sudo chown -R "$USER:$USER" "${MODELS_DIR}/comfy"

# .env
MODELS_DIR=$HOME/models

docs.title: Output layout permissions
docs.text:
doctor requires ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR} (default /mnt/comfy-output) to be writable by the current user (check only; no sudo). Nested comfy-user/ (and _user/_rescued) can still be root-owned after a container start — that is a warning, not a hard doctor failure.

setup and start sudo-heal each output layout dir (input/, custom-nodes-user/, comfy-user/…/_user/_rescued) when they are not writable. They do not recurse chown over generated PNG/MP4 or operator JSON.

Preferred (setup / start)Manual last resort 
./scripts/manage.sh setup
./scripts/manage.sh start
# sudo mkdir -p + chown for COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR layout dirs when needed

sudo mkdir -p "${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user/default/workflows/_user/_rescued"
sudo chown "$USER:$USER" "${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/comfy-user"

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
Each utility writes to ${MODELS_DIR}/<org__repo>_<tier> (tier_dir), then relative symlinks into comfy/:

${MODELS_DIR}/
  black-forest-labs__FLUX.2-klein-4b-fp8_fast/
  Comfy-Org__z_image_turbo_te/                # qwen_3_4b
  Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae/                   # flux2-vae
  Comfy-Org__Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged_5b/
  Lightricks__LTX-2.5_2.5/
  unsloth__Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF_llm/
  comfy/
    diffusion_models/   # relative symlinks into tier repos above
    text_encoders/
    vae/
    llm/                # Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M GGUF
    onnx/               # opt-in Kokoro ONNX (download-podcast --tier analog) + Silero VAD (download-dub)
    tts/                # opt-in Kokoro voices + Chatterbox / Qwen3-TTS / Chatterbox ML V3
    whisper/            # opt-in faster-whisper large-v3 (download-dub --tier asr)
    checkpoints/        # opt-in ACE-Step 1.5 AIO (download-music --tier turbo / download-podcast --tier acestep)
  hub/                  # HF cache (optional)

Host-wide leftovers (HF hub, Docker layers, Ollama, other inference backends) are not reap-models — use disk-wizard (--plan first). When the default pack moves (LTX 2.3 → 2.5 already happened), reap the old tree — do not wait for disk-full:

./scripts/manage.sh models-status
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --plan
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --apply --class junk --yes
./scripts/manage.sh reap-models --apply --class superseded --quarantine --yes

manage.sh cleanup is volume-only (named volume comfy-state). It does not delete weights. reap-models --plan is the default; --apply requires --yes. Shared files (flux2-vae, ACE-Step AIO) stay in the keep-set so --drop-pack cannot eat them.

download-models links weights into comfy/* with relative symlinks (e.g. ../../Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors). That way the same tree resolves on the host (MODELS_DIR=/mnt/models) and inside the container (bind-mounted at /models). Absolute /mnt/models/… file links look fine on the host but break Comfy with “exists but doesn't link anywhere”.

This matches the lab hostPath pattern so K8s and Docker demos can share weights.

flowchart TB
  Root["MODELS_DIR"]
  Root --> Klein["black-forest-labs__FLUX.2-klein-4b-fp8_fast"]
  Root --> TE["Comfy-Org__z_image_turbo_te"]
  Root --> VAE["Comfy-Org__flux2-dev_vae"]
  Root --> Wan["Comfy-Org__Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged_5b"]
  Root --> Ltx["Lightricks__LTX-2.5_2.5"]
  Root --> Llm["unsloth__Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF_llm"]
  Root --> Comfy["comfy/"]
  Root --> Hub["hub/ · optional HF cache"]
  Comfy --> DM["diffusion_models/ · symlinks"]
  Comfy --> TEd["text_encoders/"]
  Comfy --> VAEd["vae/"]
  Comfy --> LlmDir["llm/"]
  Comfy --> Onnx["onnx/ · opt-in Kokoro"]
  Comfy --> Tts["tts/ · opt-in voices"]
  Comfy --> Ckpt["checkpoints/ · opt-in ACE-Step AIO"]

docs.title: First Queue
docs.text:
Graph: audio/music/rap-draft (extra.lab_profile us-safe-music). Same role as klein-still-draft. App Duration (seconds) defaults to 32. Prefix ez_rap_draft. Full stage table: RAP-FIRST.

Then load audio/music/rap-full (96 s), or a numbered take under _lab/audio/albums/nill-bye/<album>/, or _lab/audio/albums/drive-through/<album>/.

docs.title: Download
docs.text:
Music weights are opt-in. ./scripts/manage.sh download-models does not pull them. doctor prints turbo JSON and still exits 0 when the pack is absent.

./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo     # ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors (~10 GB)
./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier xl        # optional XL split only
# same --limit auto|N|off wrap as download-models (always clears on exit)

Turbo uses the same snapshot as download-podcast --tier acestep:

${MODELS_DIR}/Comfy-Org__ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files_acestep/checkpoints/ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors
${MODELS_DIR}/comfy/checkpoints/ace_step_1.5_turbo_aio.safetensors   # relative symlink

If you already ran download-podcast --tier acestep, download-music --tier turbo is a cache hit + relink. Do not download the 10 GB AIO twice.

Relative symlinks only (host /mnt/models vs container /models).

docs.title: Sequential Queue
docs.text:
1. ./scripts/manage.sh download-music --tier turbo
  2. ./scripts/manage.sh start — type yes
  3. Load audio/music/rap-draft. Enhance on. Queue. Files under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR} as ez_rap_draft_*.flac / ez_rap_draft_*.mp3
  4. Then load audio/music/rap-full (96 s), or a numbered take under _lab/audio/albums/nill-bye/<album>/, or _lab/audio/albums/drive-through/<album>/. Full album: ./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album nill-bye/peer-review --art skip|upload|generate
  5. Album art: App Album art skip (default) / upload (wire Cover image in graph view) / generate, or album-render --art skip|upload|generate. Generate queues cover.json (klein occupancy) then POST /free then ACE tracks. Cover LoadImage is unwired so App Queue does not require a file. Do not co-resident Klein + ACE. Generic stills: klein/thumbnail or klein/podcast-cover in a later session.
  6. Optional YouTube still-image video (host ffmpeg; graphs still save FLAC + MP3):
./scripts/manage.sh audio-still-video \
  --audio "${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_rap_full_00001_.flac" \
  --image "${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_thumbnail_00001_.png"
# → ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/ez_rap_full_00001_.mp4
# Square covers letterbox onto 1920×1080. Shorts: --size 1080x1920

Spark: the AIO is ~10 GB VRAM-adjacent work. Do not co-resident with LTX / Wan / Klein.

Start still requires typing yes. Compose restart: "no" is unchanged.

docs.title: Occupancy desk
docs.text:
What's on this page

  • Why GB10 is still one heavy GPU job
  • Modes: idle, blender-desk, llm-desk, klein, trellis, wan, ltx — matrix: Occupancy matrix
  • Park Comfy with POST /free instead of stop for Workbench dumps or the 35B sidecar
  • What stays XOR (NVENC, Cycles CUDA, LTX next to TRELLIS, llm-desk next to blender-desk)
  • Graph occupancy label llm (Prompt Forge) is not a CLI mode
  • In-tree MCP: blender-mcp (desk) and research-mcp (GPU sidecar when llm-desk; CPU 4B as OOM fallback; Path D) — tools: MCP

What this enables

  • Host Blender clay dumps without typing yes on a full start cycle every time
  • An opt-in 35B writing desk (llm-desk) while Comfy weights are parked
  • A later TRELLIS (optional/klein/trellis2) or LTX Queue after Blender / the sidecar is stopped
  • Unchanged restart: "no", heavy confirm, mem_limit: 90g, headroom 28 GiB

One heavy job

Parked Comfy is not a second denoise. blender-desk is Workbench / CPU after models unload. llm-desk is the host 35B llama-server after models unload — that sidecar is the GPU job. Cycles CUDA, TRELLIS, Wan, LTX, and llm-desk still XOR with each other. This does not weaken restart: "no", headroom, or download-limit clear-on-exit.

docs.title: Modes
docs.text:
Mode Compose Comfy weights 35B sidecar GPU job idle down — stopped none blender-desk up or down POST /free unload when up stopped Workbench / CPU dumps llm-desk up or down POST /free unload when up running (127.0.0.1:30000) host llama-server GGUF klein up, 90g/80g Klein 4B stopped stills trellis up, 90g/80g TRELLIS.2 INT8 stopped image→mesh wan / ltx up, 90g/80g video stopped 5s print

App occupancy keys (none / llm / klein / …) on Prompt Forge and research-chat are graph labels. llm means nothing GPU. It is not occupancy enter llm. Mode × legal GPU jobs: Occupancy matrix.

./scripts/manage.sh occupancy status
./scripts/manage.sh blender-install   # once; occupancy does not install Blender
./scripts/manage.sh occupancy enter blender-desk
./scripts/manage.sh blender -- --background
./scripts/manage.sh occupancy enter llm-desk --yes
# OpenAI-compatible: http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1
./scripts/manage.sh occupancy enter trellis --yes

One-time 35B pull (throttled; not download-models):

./scripts/manage.sh download-llm --tier qwen36-35b-a3b

Host llama-server must be on PATH (aarch64). Missing binary prints a host-install hint and exits 1 — do not apt/pip inside Docker. vLLM + nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is an operator alternative only (not wired). Path D: ssh -L 30000:127.0.0.1:30000.

occupancy enter does not start Compose. Heavy modes tell you to ./scripts/manage.sh start (type yes) when the container is down.

State lives at ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/.occupancy.json (outputs, never MODELS_DIR). In-canvas Occupancy gate (EZDCCOccupancyGate) reads that file only — it does not start Compose or spawn Blender. Stay in Comfy after a Blender dump.

docs.title: Park vs stop
docs.text:
stop is the hammer: container down, volumes kept. Use it for NVENC proxies, SuperSplat, or a wedged UI.

occupancy enter blender-desk keeps Compose up, waits for an empty queue, then POST /free {unload_models, free_memory} (the Manager unload). Host Workbench dumps (export-guides, blender-stills, house-views, blender) are allowed. NVENC still dies if compose is up.

If /free fails, Workbench may still contend for unified memory — occupancy idle then.

docs.title: What this is not
docs.text:
• Not a Compose profile for Blender (Blender stays a host binary)
  • Not Cycles GPU / OptiX while Compose is up
  • Not lowering mem_limit: 90g or min_host_free_gib: 28
  • Not two denoises (Klein + LTX, TRELLIS + LTX, Wan + TRELLIS)
  • Not occupancy enter llm (graph label only). Use llm-desk for the 35B sidecar.

docs.title: MCP (mcp-construct)
docs.text:
Tool tables and Path D tunnels: MCP.

In-tree MCP servers are typed-tool stdio processes. No execute_code, no telemetry. Official Comfy Cloud MCP / comfy-mcp stay out of the image (manage.sh start is the launch path).

blender-mcp wraps occupancy and host Blender (primitives, camera, keyframes, GLB, guide dumps). No cloud 3D APIs. bpy tools need blender-desk.

./scripts/manage.sh occupancy enter blender-desk
./scripts/manage.sh blender-mcp --stdio
# optional on-box 4B (CPU, same GGUF as prompt-enhance):
./scripts/manage.sh blender-llm "greybox mug on a table, dump still mug"

Qwen3-4B will place primitives. Cinematic scenes: Path D — laptop Grok/Cursor as the MCP client over SSH, Spark only runs blender-mcp. If llama-cli is missing, blender-llm prints that hint and exits 1.

research-mcp is the creative-process desk (chat, web search, sequential research subagents, list_lab_apps / describe_app). Graph occupancy llm: GPU 35B sidecar when llm-desk is up (http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1 on the host; host.docker.internal from Comfy). CPU 4B only if the sidecar is down or occupancy is Wan/LTX/TRELLIS. It does not refuse a GPU Comfy session and does not map idle → blender-desk or llm-desk. Same pipeline as inspire/research-chat. HTTPS search is SSRF-guarded (no arbitrary fetch_url tool).

./scripts/manage.sh research-mcp --stdio
./scripts/manage.sh research-mcp --call research '{"message":"night rooftop lighting"}'

Path D: laptop agent is the MCP client; Spark runs research-mcp. Briefs land under ${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/research/ (never MODELS_DIR). Copy prompt ingredients into Prompt Forge, then Spark Still. MCP does not Queue Comfy.

Related: Occupancy matrix · MCP · ComfyUI Apps · Blender GB10 sidecar · Studio sidecars · Hardware, memory, and safety · Architecture · Troubleshooting — studio canvas.

docs.title: Two operator paths
docs.text: Do not load Klein + Wan + LTX + ACE-Step + TTS in one session. Cover art is a separate graph.

docs.title: Option A — audio-first commercial episode
docs.text:
Graph: audio/podcast/audio-first (extra.lab_profile us-safe-podcast).

Stage What runs Prefix SCRIPT App Script + Rewrite script. In-tree EZPodcastScript (enhance off so Speaker A: / Speaker B: stay parser input). Missing GGUF passes the widget through ez_podcast_script DISCLOSURE EZPodcastDisclosure prepends the spoken bumper (string) VOICES App Speaker A / B, Include announcer, Speaking speed. EZKokoroTTS Kokoro-82M ONNX/CPU built-ins. Voice-clone refs stay graph-only ez_podcast_voice BEDS App Bed tags, Rewrite bed, Bed length (seconds). First spoken line is always:
